is_anopheles.evidence: Studies field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. from Burkina Faso (Page 3-4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports PCR genotyping for kdr L1014F (Vgsc L995F), kdr L1014S (Vgsc L995S), and ace-1R G119S (Ace-1 G280S) (Page 5, 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports summary allele frequencies for kdr (L1014F: 0.95-0.98, L1014S: 0.4-0.33) and ace-1R (0.12) in text (Page 8) but does not state the number of mosquitoes genotyped (sample size N) nor raw genotype or allele counts.

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae collected from breeding sites in Dobao, Kompla, and Soumousso in Burkina Faso (Page 3-4).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field and laboratory study.

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific villages of Dobao (11° 06' 38.9" N, 3° 00' 35.9" W), Kompla (11° 06' 6.0" N, 3° 00' 2" W), and Soumousso (11° 01' 46" N, 4° 02' 45" W) in Burkina Faso (Page 3-4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collections took place during the rainy season from June to November 2013 (Page 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard primary research study with new collections from 2013.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files S1 and S2 Table contain chromatographic analysis data, not mosquito genotype data.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated agricultural pesticide runoff and insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. from conventional and biological cotton-growing areas in southwestern Burkina Faso in 2013. While bioassays, net cone tests, and chemical residue analyses were performed, and kdr (L1014F/S) and ace-1R (G119S) allele frequencies are stated in text, the study does not report the number of genotyped mosquitoes or raw genotype/allele counts, rendering the genotype data non-extractable.
exclusion_reasons: Lacks extractable genotype data: reports allele frequencies for Vgsc L1014F, L1014S, and Ace-1 G119S without specifying the number of mosquitoes genotyped or providing genotype/allele counts.
